honesty.label: honesty
honesty.nudge: Someone may be carrying a lie they want to put down. Grace before truth lands well.

anger.label: anger
anger.nudge: Anger is in the room for someone. Name it as human before naming it as sin.

lust.label: lust
lust.nudge: Someone is fighting a private battle. Talk about the way out God provides, not the shame.

pride.label: pride
pride.nudge: Pride rarely knows it is pride. Model the lowest seat this week.

envy.label: envy
envy.nudge: Comparison is stealing someone's joy. A word on contentment lands well.

addiction.label: addiction
addiction.nudge: Someone is losing a fight alone. Make it normal to ask for a hand this week.

anxiety.label: anxiety
anxiety.nudge: Someone's mind will not slow down. Rest and the nearness of God are the words.

fear.label: fear
fear.nudge: Fear is close for someone. "Do not be afraid" is the most repeated command for a reason.

grief.label: grief
grief.nudge: Someone is grieving. Leave room for silence; do not rush to the lesson.

loneliness.label: loneliness
loneliness.nudge: Someone feels unseen. Learn a name, ask a second question, sit next to them.

shame.label: shame
shame.nudge: Shame is whispering to someone. Say out loud that there is no condemnation in Christ.

doubt.label: doubt
doubt.nudge: Someone is doubting and afraid to say so. Make doubt speakable this week.

marriage.label: marriage
marriage.nudge: A marriage in the room is under strain. Patience and bearing with one another are the words.

parenting.label: parenting
parenting.nudge: Someone is carrying their children. A word for tired parents lands well.

family.label: family
family.nudge: Family is heavy for someone. Honour and forgiveness both need saying.

friendship.label: friendship
friendship.nudge: A friendship has cracked for someone. Talk about what a brother born for adversity looks like.

work.label: work
work.nudge: Work is weighing on someone. Whom we really work for is the word.

money.label: money
money.nudge: Money is tight for someone. Say plainly that the group helps each other, and how.

health.label: health
health.nudge: Someone's body is failing them. Pray for healing and for grace in weakness, both.

burnout.label: burnout
burnout.nudge: Someone is running on empty. Rest is not a reward; say so.

purpose.label: purpose
purpose.nudge: Someone is asking what it is all for. Talk about faithfulness in the small and ordinary.

identity.label: identity
identity.nudge: Someone doubts they belong. Say who they are to God before what they do for Him.

forgiveness.label: forgiveness
forgiveness.nudge: Someone is deciding whether to forgive. Do not rush it; do not skip it.

gratitude.label: gratitude
gratitude.nudge: Someone is full of thanks. Give it a minute of the room; gratitude is contagious.

prayer.label: prayer
prayer.nudge: Someone wants to pray better and feels behind. Keep it simple and honest.

church.label: church
church.nudge: Church has been complicated for someone. Listen longer than you speak.

decision.label: decision
decision.nudge: A decision is looming for someone. Wisdom, counsel, and peace are the words.

temptation.label: temptation
temptation.nudge: Someone keeps falling in the same place. Talk about the way out, and about company on the way.

patience.label: patience
patience.nudge: Someone is tired of waiting. Waiting on the Lord is different from waiting around; say how.

hope.label: hope
hope.nudge: Hope is thin for someone. The God of hope is the word, not a pep talk.
